## Outreach brief

- **Lewis & Clark — San Diego, California admissions contact:** **Qwadere “Q” Lovell**, **Senior Assistant Dean of Admissions**. Territory shown: **Southern California** (the regional county list assigns him **San Diego**).  
  **Email:** qlovell@lclark.edu · **Phone:** 503-713-1203 · **Office:** Frank Manor House · **Based/hometown listed:** Los Angeles, California.  
  Sources: [L&C regional representative profile](https://college.lclark.edu/live/profiles/13789-qwadere-q-lovell) and [California county assignment page](https://college.lclark.edu/admissions/staff/counties/) (the latter presently appears to have a broken/retired URL, but was the official county-list result identifying San Diego).

- **Hunter College Silberman MSW — Fall 2026:** **Application deadline: March 1; supporting-document deadline: March 15.** The page applies these fall dates to the Two-Year Full-Time, Bank Street dual-degree, Advanced Standing, and One-Year Residency tracks; it separately repeats March 1/March 15 for the DOHMH scholarship residency program.  
  Source: [Silberman admissions deadlines](https://sssw.hunter.cuny.edu/admissions/deadlines/).

- **Indiana University Kokomo — graduate programs:**  
  **Master’s:** Master of Business Administration; M.S. in Management; M.S. in Strategic Finance; Master of Public Management; M.S. in Nursing; M.A. in Mental Health Counseling; M.S.Ed. in Teaching, Learning, and Curriculum; M.S.Ed. in the Science of Reading; online M.A. in English; online M.A. in History; online Master of Liberal Studies; and online M.S. in Criminal Justice and Public Safety.  
  **Graduate certificates listed through IU Kokomo/its IU regional-online offerings:** Alcohol and Drug Counseling; Business Analytics; Leadership; Public Management; Nursing Education; Nursing Administration; English certificates in Literature, Language and Literature, and Composition Studies; Biology; Chemistry; Mathematics; and Communication Studies.  
  Source: [IU Kokomo Graduate Programs](https://kokomo.iu.edu/graduate-programs/index.html).  
  *Note:* IU’s current landing page renders its master’s/certificate lists as interactive content; the program names above reflect the offerings surfaced by that official page and its linked IU Kokomo/IU bulletin program materials.

- **UCSF glioblastoma trials — actively accepting/recruiting in Northern California:**  
  1. **Anti-EGFRvIII synNotch Receptor Induced Anti-EphA2/IL-13Ralpha2 CAR (E‑SYNC) T Cells** — **Status: accepting new patients**; **UCSF location:** San Francisco, California 94143.  
     Source: [individual UCSF trial page](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/trial/NCT06186401).  
  2. **DOC1021 Dendritic Cell Immunotherapy for Treatment of Newly Diagnosed Adult Glioblastoma (GBM)** — **Status: accepting new patients**; **UCSF location:** San Francisco, California 94143. (Its page also lists City of Hope in Duarte, California.)  
     Source: [individual UCSF trial page](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/trial/NCT06805305).  
  UCSF’s [glioblastoma-trials index](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/glioblastoma) labels these as open to eligible people. Trial eligibility is individualized; this is outreach information, not medical advice.

- **ORU student activities/student-experience lead:** **Augustine Mendoza**, listed by ORU Student Association as **Director of Student Experience**; ORU’s subsequent announcement identifies him as **Senior Director of Spiritual Life and Student Experience**.  
  **Official ORU contact shown:** **augiemendoza@oru.edu**.  
  Source: ORU’s Student Association Cabinet listing (currently surfaced in ORU search results) and [ORU’s leadership announcement](https://oru.edu/news/oru_news/oru-unveils-exciting-student-life-reorganization.php).

- **EDF Energy — salary-review language:** I could verify EDF’s current official [Graduate Careers page](https://careers.edfenergy.com/graduate-careers), but it **does not now contain salary-review language for new hires**. I therefore can’t responsibly provide an “exact” quotation on that point from the live official graduate-programme page. The currently live page focuses on programme options, applications, and recruitment FAQs; it does not state a salary-review policy.
